JSON (a top-level array, or an object with an items / prompts array):
[
 {"id":"kr2-001","title":"Rainy night street","category":"Fashion",
 "tags":["street","night"],"prompt":"……"}
]
· Each item only needs a non-empty prompt; title / category / tags / id are filled in if missing
· Duplicate ids are dropped; one prompt is at most 10,000 characters; the file is at most 20 MB

TXT (UTF-8):
· Blank lines split prompts; each block is one prompt
· Category is stored as Uncategorized; the title is the first 20 characters

Advanced gacha needs gacha-server-lite running on your PC:
1. Clone the repo (or download the ZIP)
2. Install Python 3.10+; start.bat installs the dependencies on its first run
3. Double-click start.bat (default port 8787) and keep the window open
4. Enter http://<PC LAN IP>:8787 here
Your phone and PC must be on the same LAN.
Can\'t reach the roll service. Open it on the computer and check the address.
Roll service address is not valid
The roll service returned no prompt
A VPN is on — this may be the wrong subnet. Try turning the VPN off.
Filled in — tap Test connection to confirm
Nothing found. Please check each item:
ComfyUI is running and was started with --listen
Phone and computer are on the same Wi-Fi
VPN / accelerator on the phone is off
The computer\'s firewall allows port 8188 (roll service: 8787)
VPN / accelerator on the phone is off (a VPN is currently on)
If it still fails, enter the address manually.
Guest networks and router AP isolation can also block discovery

To reach ComfyUI on your computer, Android 17 asks for separate permission to access nearby devices. Tap Grant and the system will show the prompt. It is only used to connect to the server you enter and find computers on your network — nothing is uploaded.
Without this permission the phone can\'t reach computers on the local network.
Local network access not allowed — tap to enable
That address doesn\'t look right. Example: http://PC-IP:8188
Can\'t reach the computer on the local network. On Android 17, allow Nearby devices (local network) for this app in system settings first, then retry.
Connection timed out. The phone and the computer may be on different networks, or a firewall is blocking that port.
The computer refused the connection. ComfyUI may not be running, the port may be wrong (default 8188), or it wasn\'t started with --listen.
Network unreachable. Make sure the phone is on the same Wi-Fi and turn off any VPN.
Can\'t resolve that name. Check the spelling or your network.
